crossRefs.note: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

translations.web: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”
translations.bsb: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
translations.kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
translations.asv: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, Therefore will I give praise unto thee among the Gentiles, And sing unto thy name.
